questions: How should attributes of XML elements be represented in the CSV? Are they omitted, included as separate columns, or merged with the tag or text?
What should be done with elements that have no text content (e.g., empty or self-closing tags)? Should they be omitted, included with empty string, or something else?
Does 'preserving order as iterated' mean depth-first traversal (as in root.iter()) or some other order like breadth-first?
Should the CSV include a header row? If so, what should the column names be?
How should whitespace-only text nodes (e.g., indentation) be handled? Should they be trimmed, kept as-is, or ignored?
What encoding should be used for reading the XML string? Is it always UTF-8, or should it be inferred from XML declaration?
If an element has both text and nested elements, should the text appear in the same row as the element's tag, or separately?
Should the root element itself be included in the CSV output, or only its descendants?
